The '''1970 [[Eliteserien|1. divisjon]]''' was the 26th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]].

==Overview==
It was contested by 10 teams, and [[Strømsgodset Toppfotball|Strømsgodset]] won the championship, their first league title.
